environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 directly to the container on port 8080. The service is publicly accessible via the ALB DNS name. The ADMIN_ENCRYPTION_KEY is set to a weak default value '0123456789abcdef' in the task definition environment variables. No CloudFront distribution is configured; clients connect directly to the ALB endpoint.

config.load_balancer: ALB public-facing, port 443 -> target group port 8080
config.network: Public subnets, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on 443
